## Overview
AI-Based Research Paper Analysis Using Transformer Models


## Main Ideas
- Automating literature reviews using transformer-based language models
- Evaluating the effectiveness of AI models in analyzing research papers
- Comparing performance across summarization, topic extraction, and research gap identification tasks


## Key Findings
- Transformer-based models achieved high accuracy (over 85%) in summarization tasks
- Models performed well in topic extraction with an average F1-score of approximately 0.88
- Research gap identification was more challenging but still suggested meaningful future research directions
